title: Search Code Output
description: Output structure for code search results using ripgrep

file_path.description: Path to the file containing the match

line_number.description: Line number where the match was found

line_content.description: Full line content containing the match

match_text.description: The actual text that matched the pattern

context_before.description: Lines of code before the match for context

context_after.description: Lines of code after the match for context

search_pattern.description: The pattern that was searched for

file_types_searched.description: File types that were included in the search

search_duration_ms.description: Time taken to perform the search in milliseconds
